claims.quote: This packet reports per-node, per-role discrete location distributions
claims.reason: Packet contains per-panel per-node entries with separate blue/red distributions

claims.quote: on separate 4x4 local grids.
claims.reason: coordinate_system rows=4, columns=4, separate_local_grids=true

claims.quote: copied prior records are historical (not new estimates)
claims.reason: Origins include kinds labeled copied_prior_record/inherited_current, implying copied prior records rather than newly computed estimates

claims.quote: conditional command records are hypothetical branches (not executed events).
claims.reason: packet.candidate_semantics = "conditional supplied record or estimate, not an executed branch" and candidate origins labeled as conditional/native_conditional_record/command_estimate

claims.quote: n0 in both panels shows blue concentrated at cell (0,1)
claims.reason: current entries for n0 in p0 and p1 show derived.blue.peaks = [[0,1]] and peak_probability ~0.9823

claims.quote: and red at (0,3);
claims.reason: current entries for n0 in p0 and p1 show derived.red.peaks = [[0,3]] and peak_probability ~0.999998

claims.quote: n1 ... are uniform across their grids for both roles;
claims.reason: current entries for n1 in p0 and p1 show derived.peaks listing all 16 cells and distributions all 0.0625

claims.quote: n2 are uniform across their grids for both roles;
claims.reason: current entries for n2 in p0 and p1 show derived.peaks listing all 16 cells and distributions all 0.0625

claims.quote: p0 current n3 concentrates blue at (1,2)
claims.reason: p0 current n3 derived.blue.peaks = [[1,2]] with peak_probability ~0.95084

claims.quote: and red at (0,1);
claims.reason: p0 current n3 derived.red.peaks = [[0,1]] with peak_probability ~0.992185

claims.quote: p1 current n3 is uniform.
claims.reason: p1 current n3 derived.peaks list all 16 cells and distributions equal (0.0625) for both roles

claims.quote: Candidate (k0/k1/k2) records reproduce the same n0	6n2 patterns;
claims.reason: candidate entries for k0/k1/k2 in both panels have identical derived for n0,n1,n2 matching current patterns (peaks/distributions)

claims.quote: n3 varies by panel and command:
claims.reason: candidate entries for n3 differ across panels (p0 vs p1) and across commands (k0/k1/k2) in their derived peaks and distributions

claims.quote: p0 candidates consistently peak blue at (1,2)
claims.reason: p0 candidates k0/k1/k2 derived.blue.peaks = [[1,2]] in all three commands

claims.quote: and red at (0,1)
claims.reason: p0 candidates k0/k1/k2 derived.red.peaks = [[0,1]] in all three commands

claims.quote: with peak probabilities near 0.95	60.99;
claims.reason: p0 candidates show peak_probability values ~0.9508, 0.9762, 0.9454 for blue and ~0.9922, 0.9872, 0.9793 for red (within 0.95-0.99 range)

claims.quote: p1 candidates include a uniform branch (k0)
claims.reason: p1 candidate k0 derived.blue.peaks lists all 16 cells and distributions equal (0.0625)

claims.quote: branches with blue peaks on the lower-right quadrant or at (1,2)
claims.reason: p1 candidate k1 derived.blue.peaks = [[0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]] and k2 has [[1,2]]; the quoted phrase asserts lower-right quadrant for some peaks which does not match k1 peaks (these are rows 0-1, cols 2-3) so the quadrant claim is incorrect

claims.quote: and corresponding red peaks on (0,1) or the upper-left quadrant.
claims.reason: p1 k2 derived.red.peaks = [[0,1]] and p1 k1 derived.red.peaks = [[0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]] (upper-left quadrant), matching the claim

claims.quote: Differences across command-conditioned distributions are reflected above and in the per-distribution peak lists.
claims.reason: candidate distributions differ by command and per-distribution derived.peaks reflect those differences throughout the packet
